Chloe / Marissa —

Agree with Chloe's proposal; a few adjustments from a packaging and risk perspective:
- Pilot credit: $12k applied up-front to the first invoice (reduces refund/credit complexity).
- Burst blocks: sell in 100k-token increments billed at 1.5x baseline token rate, with a soft cap of 4 blocks per month.
- Commit baseline: a small committed monthly floor tied to the forecast (we should avoid open-ended free usage).
- SLA/Capacity guard: include automatic fallback to a quantized LLM or reduced concurrency if we detect sustained >72-hour burst to protect capacity for other customers.

I also recommend conditioning the credit on a short mutual action plan (MAP) with 3 clear success criteria (integration health, quality of outputs, and go/no-go by end of pilot). That helps with renewals and prevents gaming the credit.

If you're okay I can draft a one-page memo for Markus to sign off (CFO) and a corresponding line on the commercial term sheet.

—Karthik
